sheet.title: Record snapshots
sheet.description: Enter the current balance of each holding on one date. Rows you leave blank are skipped, and the filled rows are saved together: all of them or none.
sheet.empty: No open holdings to record a snapshot for. Add a product to an investment account first.
sheet.conflict: Another change got in the way: one of these snapshots was written at the same moment. Nothing was saved and your balances are still here, so try saving again.
